tei:div.tei:p: bla ma bde mchog 'khor lo'i bdag 'jug ye shes snang ba myur 'dren zhes bya ba bzhugs so// nges pa'i gsang ba rgyal kun mnyam nyid kyang*/ /thugs rje'i shing rta'i mthu las mchog dngos dbyig /rtsol med ster mdzad dpal mgon bla ma nyid/ /bde mchog 'khor los shar bas bdag skyongs shig /dbang gis slob ma smin par byed pa dang*/ sgrub mchod dang sgrub chen skabs su nyer mkhor gyur pa'i bdag 'jug bya bar 'dod pas/ dkyil 'khor dang dbang rdzas gzhung mthun ltar tshogs par byas la/ bdag mdun gzhung bsrangs la bzlas pa dang*/ bum bzlas kyang byas mthar lha 'od zhu bya/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis khrus bya/ rtsa sngags dang sum+bha nis bgegs bskrad/ badz+ra kro dha rak+ṣas srung 'khor bsgoms/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ tsak+ṣu bhan+dha wa ra ma na yas mig dar 'ching*/ a khaṃ wi ra hūm̐ gis me tog gtad/ dga' chen ston pa he ru ka /khyab bdag pad+ma badz+ra rtsal/ /bdag la brtse bas nyer dgongs nas/ /smin grol byin gyi brlab tu gsol kyis gsol ba gdab/ badz+ra a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭha: dam chu 'thung*/ na mo: bla ma 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog: sogs skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed mkha' khyab sogs sems bskyed/ rdo rje slob dpon sogs rgyun bshags bya/ oṃ/ bde bar gshegs pa khyed ci 'dra/ /de 'dra kho nar bdag gyur cig /spyod pa rmad byung bsam yas pa/ /'gro la phan phyir bdag gis spyad/ /byang chub sems mchog dam pa dang*/ /sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya ni/ /srog gi phyir yang mi gtong na/ /rdo rje rgyal pos byin rlabs mdzod/ /ces sdom pa bzung*/ ye shes pa dbab pa'i phyir/ slob dpon thugs nas bde chen gyi: 'od zer me lce lta bu 'phros: slob ma'i lus la reg pa'i mod: rnam smin phung po stong par bsregs: dwangs ma rdul bral hūm̐ dmar po: zhal zhugs thugs kar 'od du zhu: skad cig khrag 'thung yab dang yum: lus dkyil lha dang bcas pa gsal:

kha nas phyung ste shar sgo ru: seng ges btegs pa'i rin chen dang : pad+ma nyi ma'i khri la 'khod: gnas gsum 'bru gsum hūm̐ yig gi: 'od zer lcags kyus mkha' khyab kyi: ye shes gsang gsum phyag rgyar drangs: spyi bo nas zhugs snying gar thim: bde chen ye shes phebs par bsam: spos rol dbyangs kyis bskul te tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang*/ ma hā gu ru shrī he ru ka dzñā na sa twa a be sha ya: s+t+waṃ bha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya: ra ra ra ra: tsā la ya tsā la ya hūm̐ āḥha dzhaiṃ: zhes brjod dbab/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brtan par bya/ rat+na mā la pra tīts+tsha hoḥ me tog dor/ puṣ+pe mā la ghṛh+ṇa hoḥs me tog spyi bor bzhag /dzñā na tsak+ṣu pra bai sha ya phaṭa kyis mig dar bsal/ ye shes dag pa'i mig thob pas slob dpon dang rang gi lus la gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams mngon sum bzhin du mthong bar mos mdzod/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la/ /mchog chen ji ltar bstsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rjes deng bdag stsol/ lan gsum/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha nam mkha' gang bar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*/ /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces pas bstod/ rdo rje can gyi sangs rgyas la/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang*/ /yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar bstsal/ /de ltar 'di la'ang bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dgongs pa mdzad/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis shis pa brjod de/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /thabs cad bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /ma lus sems can bskyed byed bde ba chen po ste/

/des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /srid pa gsum 'bar sku ni rjes chags dul bar ldan/ /'od zer sngon po stong ldan nyi ma brgya stong ldan/ /rnam mang sku dang cha lugs rjes chags sems dpar ldan/ /he ru ka dpal de dang lhan cig gar byed shog /ces brjod cing me tog gis char dbab/ sems ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu blangs/ khro bo khro mo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ rigs kyi yum lngas rdo rje'i bdud rtsi'i chus bkang ba'i bum pa thogs te mngon par dbang bskur bar gyur/ rnam bum thogs la/ hūm̐: mkha' khyab rgyal ba sras bcas kyis: bkra shis bum pa bzung nas ni: ye shes bdud rtsis dbang bskur bas: tha mal snang zhen dag par shog: oṃ pad+ma badz+ra ma hā su kha sarba sid+dhi hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ: hrīḥhūm̐ trām̐ oṃ āḥ ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa mi: zhes bum chu 'thor 'thung bya/ gtso bo bde mchog pad+ma badz+ra'i sku dang*/ gnas so so'i lha las gnyis pa re byon/ slob ma'i lus dang gnas so sor thim pas snang stong sku'i ye shes bskyed par mos shig /tsakli rnams gnas so sor bzhag /hūm̐: bde mchog 'bar ba'i pho brang nas: pad+ma badz+ra yab yum gyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: sku dang ye shes yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ pad+ma badz+ra kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa mi: hūm̐: byin rlabs klong yangs pho brang nas: bla ma rig 'dzin yab yum gyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: rdo rje'i ye shes mngon gyur shog: oṃ ma hā gu ru badz+ra dharma kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa mi: hūm̐: bkod pa tshad med pho brang nas: thod phreng rigs lnga yab yum gyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: nyon mongs phung po rang grol shog /oṃ badz+ra gu ru thod phreng rtsal sarba kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa mi: hūm̐: lha dang dbyer med pho brang nas: dpal chen rig 'dzin yab yum gyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: tshogs yul rtog pa rang grol shog:

oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa mi: hūm̐: tshad med bzhi ldan pho brang nas: bde chen rigs bzhi'i dhā ki nīs: rigasakyi bu la dbang bskur bas: dga' bzhi'i ye shes mngon gyur shog: oṃ dhā ki nī sarba kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa mi: hūm̐: nyer bzhi'i yul gyi pho brang nas: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yab yum gyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: yon tan rtsal rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ bī ra yo gi nī sarba kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa mi: hūm̐: dur khrod gnas brgyad pho brang nas: sgo mtshams sbyor ba'i pho nya mos: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: phrin las mthar phyin dbang thob shog: oṃ karma dhā ki nī sarba kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa mi: deng phyin chad lha sku phyag rgya'i gzer brtan g.yo kun la btab ste tha mal gyi dngos po thams cad snang stong lha yi 'khor lor 'char ba la brtson par gyis shig /sngags phreng mgrin par bzhag la/ āḥ lha sngags dbyer med bkod pa dang : bde chen spro bsdus bzlas pa yis: 'gyu ba'i rlung khams sngags su dag: gsung gi ye shes 'grub par shog: wā ka dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ deng phyin chad snying po sngags kyi gzer dang 'phro 'du phrin las kyi gzer brtan g.yo'i sgra skad kun la btab ste tha mal gyi sgra grags thams cad grags stong gsung gi 'khor lor 'char ba la brtson par gyis shig /me long bstan la/ hrī: 'di ltar snang zhing grags pa kun: gsal stong me long gzugs brnyan ltar: chos nyid don gyi dbang bskur bas: thugs kyi ye shes 'grub par shog: tsit+ta dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: deng phyin chad dgongs pa mi 'gyur ba'i gzer 'khor 'das kyi rtog tshogs kun la btab ste dran rtog rang ga ma'i 'phro 'du thams cad rig stong thugs kyi 'khor lor 'char ba la brtson par gyis shig /nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang lha rnams kyang rang la thim pas dbang gi ye shes skyes brtan gong du 'phel bar gyur/

ye dharma dang su pra tiṣ+ṭhas me tog 'thor/ de ltar bum pa'i dbang bskur bas: brtan g.yo'i snang zhen dri ma dag: phyi nang bskyed rim bsgom la dbang : 'bras bu sprul sku mngon du gyur: gsang dbang ni/ bla ma bde mchog pad+ma badz+ra rtsal yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi lce thog tu bzhag par gyur/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi thogs la/ āḥ zhu bdes drangs pa'i byang sems hūm̐: dmar gsal chags pa'i mdangs 'od 'tsher: rtsa khams rlung la dbyer med thim: mi rtog ye shes mngon gyur shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ma hā su kha sarba sid+dhi hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bdud rtsi myang*/ de ltar gsang ba'i dbang bskur bas: sku gang rtog pa'i dri ma dag: bdag byin brlabs sogs bsgom la dbang : 'bras bu longs sku mngon du gyur: sher dbang ni/ rigs kyi mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs shing gzugs dang lang tsho'i mdzes pa phul du byung ba'i phyag rgya mo gtad par mos shig rig tsaka gam dril bu blang la/ rdo rje btsun mo'i chu skyes ni: bde chen ye shes 'byung ba'i gnas: snyoms par 'jug pa'i sbyor ba yis: bde ba dam pa myong bar gyis: karma mu dra dzñā na sid+dhi hūm̐: rang dang rig ma 'du shes gsum gyis snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba bzhi'i rim pas lhan skyes kyi bde ba rgyud la skyes par gyur/ de ltar gsum pa'i dbang bskur bas: zag bcas thig le'i dri ma dag: pho nya'i ye shes bsgom la dbang : 'bras bu chos sku mngon du gyur: dbang bzhi pa ni/ snying ga'i zla gdan la 'khod pa'i hūm̐ la sems gtad de/ ho: khams gsum snod bcud gzung 'dzin kun: bsam mi khyab pa'i ye shes ngang : spang blang bsal bzhag bral bar bskyangs: gzung 'dzin rtog pa'i dri ma dag: yang dag nges don rtog par gyis: dharma dhā tu dzñā na a: hūm̐ yig stong nyid kyi ngang du yal bar mos la mnyam par bzhag

/de ltar bzhi pa'i dbang bskur bas: gzung 'dzin rtog pa'i dri ma dag: bsam gyis mi khyab bsgom la dbang : 'bras bu nyid sku mngon du byas: rjes/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas brtsam sogs spyi ltar dang*/ dbang gis smin cing sogs tshogs mchod sogs las byang gi rjes rim las 'jug par bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang tshul 'di'i sgrub chen rgyun 'dzugs la nyer mkhor gyur pas rig 'dzin gong ma'i phyag bzhes ltar pad+ma dbang chen dgyes pas spa gro skyer chu'i mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang du bris pa 'gro kun rdo rje bzhi yi dkyil 'khor du ngal 'tsho thob pa'i nye rgyur gyur cig/ //
